source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify BMC network configuration defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without address conflict, unintended management exposure, VLAN/routing errors, loss of the active or recovery path, or host/BMC health regression.
original_method: On an isolated management network, manually load defaults, compare named BMC network fields with SPEC, apply a bounded address/VLAN/service matrix, save/reboot, reconnect through the expected path, verify persistence and restore the approved production configuration.
manual_activity: An engineer must operate and visually accept BIOS BMC-network fields, including any apply/confirmation and reconnect behavior. Automated reachability checks are supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS/BMC identity and exact network-field/application semantics
Dedicated/shared NIC mode, MAC/port identity and switch/VLAN topology
Approved IPv4/IPv6, static/DHCP, prefix/mask, gateway, DNS, VLAN and service values
Address reservation/conflict check and expected activation/reboot timing
Independent local console plus reconnect/rollback path and secret-safe credentials
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random, reuse a production address or alter unspecified management services/protocols.
Use an isolated management network and verify address reservation, VLAN and port identity before applying values.
Keep an independent local console; the active BMC session is not an independent recovery path.
Do not expose credentials/tokens or enable insecure services as a connectivity shortcut.
Stop on conflict, unintended subnet/service exposure, last-path loss, wrong-NIC change, boot or BMC health degradation.
Restore the approved final state; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only BMC network configuration where authorized and secret-safe, link/MAC/address/VLAN/routes, ARP/ND/DHCP observations, reachability, audit/session logs and host health.
Correlate loss/reconnect windows to the approved activation semantics without changing network state.
Do not drive BIOS, configure switches/DHCP/BMC, reconnect with unapproved credentials or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve exact fields, isolated topology, addresses/services, activation, reconnect and rollback.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded network changes through BIOS, then reconnect using the approved path.
Interpret persistence, exposure and health evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; direct Redfish/IPMI/WebUI network changes are a different control path and not equivalent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the BIOS method and add version-recorded, read-only secret-safe BMC configuration, link/address/VLAN, reachability and audit evidence from the isolated network.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each BIOS field to the exact BMC MAC/NIC, address family, VLAN, service and activation event; reserve test addresses, apply one bounded scenario, and verify conflict-free identity-correlated reconnect from the isolated network.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/BMC network stack, management NIC mode and lab switch/VLAN topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, Redfish/IPMI schema/tool, switch/DHCP service and network capture versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BIOS BMC-network documentation and approved management-network security/addressing standards.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random network changes with reserved identity-based scenarios, explicit activation and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds address conflict, VLAN, service exposure and reconnect coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field schema, topology, reserved values, activation, credentials policy and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cached neighbor/DNS/DHCP state can mask errors; evidence must identify the BMC by MAC and use appropriate cache/lease awareness.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve selected addresses, VLANs and services on an isolated network. Results must list protocol/service/topology exclusions and cannot claim all management-network modes.
expected_evidence: Platform/NIC identity, field/default/network matrix, reservations, approval and rollback
Baseline MAC/link/address/VLAN/routes/services, reachability, audit and host health
Load Default captures plus SPEC and safe reconnect comparison
Non-default captures, persistence, conflict checks and identity-correlated reconnect
Approved final configuration, secret-safe logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The named network configuration and default/persistence lifecycle are coherent. Exact lab values/topology are project readiness inputs, not contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The BMC network configuration lifecycle is clear. Missing isolated topology or values prevents a run but does not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual BIOS operation and adds isolated-network, identity and exposure safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its reconnect/health evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates BIOS acceptance from direct BMC control and protects independent recovery and credential boundaries.

review_improvement: Prevents a persisted address from being accepted when it conflicts, lands on the wrong VLAN/NIC, exposes services or eliminates the last management recovery path.
independent_technical_reasoning: Core acceptance requires interactive BIOS network configuration and visual verification. Automated reachability cannot perform that manual firmware work, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat network changes, resets, reconnects or rollback after conflict, exposure, access or BMC/host anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
